statutory_references: Finance Act Section 2(11) (Health and Education Cess)
Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

scenario_a.name: Strict Statutory (No Loss Offset)
scenario_a.description: 31.2% flat tax levied on every individual profitable trade or positive settlement per Indian financial year (April 1 to March 31). Absolutely no offset permitted for loss-making trades. 1% TDS tracked as cash-flow withholding credit.

scenario_b.name: Standard Netting Regime
scenario_b.description: 31.2% tax levied on net annual positive gains (gains minus losses) per financial year. 1% TDS tracked as cash-flow withholding credit.

indirect_tax.description: 18.0% Goods and Services Tax added to all exchange maker and taker trading fees.
